definition.purpose: Astra has prepared, costed and independently reviewed the Goal 062 prospective evaluation (500 histories in each of h = 1, 3, 5 × two background levels, exact family). Claude reviewed it and finds it launch-ready, but recommends adding cheap misspecified-background (B100-A) cells first (board thread 86). Your answers decide whether Astra launches as registered, amends the registration first, or holds. When you submit, Claude will post your exact answers on the board for Astra.

questions.context: Approval covers implementation and qualification of the new panel runner, the bounded run on deep-server and the independent audit as one tranche. Any scientific change or resource increase beyond the 72-hour ceiling comes back to you. The registered six cells are budgeted at about 42–50 hours of compute.

options.label: Launch as registered: the six exact-family cells only
Amend first: add the cells chosen below, have the amendment reviewed, then launch without returning to me

questions.context: Each pair adds 1,000 histories and about 2–3.5 hours, with no new reference tables needed. With all three pairs, the campaign stays under the 72-hour ceiling (about 48–60 hours). B100-A is the misspecified background that the capstone failed to identify. The final procedure has never been tested under it; only an earlier, simpler rule has (Goal 054).

options.label: B100-A background with no effect (h = 1), both background levels: false-declaration rate under misspecification
B100-A background with a real effect (h = 3), both background levels: sensitivity and bias under misspecification
Exact family with a weak effect (h = 2), both background levels: where sensitivity starts to fall

questions.prompt: If amending, which cells should be added?

definition.title: Goal 062 launch decision: six-cell evaluation of the final procedure
